svg.title: New analyst: from access request to first published dashboard
svg.desc: Column = stage · teal = touchpoint · amber note = what they think · line = how they feel, 5 delighted to 1 angry · red = pain · dashed green = opportunity Notice: The low point is access: four days and two tickets before the first query, so that is where we fix first.
